parts.text: Start a grounded pediatric dentistry oral-board case focused on pulp therapy.

property.description: The agent calls set_loading_step, search_docs, and read_doc before producing clinical case content.
The agent calls set_case with a concise vignette and source chips grounded in the retrieved documents.
The agent sets the phase to presenting, introduces the case, explains the real OCE feedback/pass-fail difference, and does not ask a clinical question yet.
If the local corpus does not cover the requested topic, the agent says so and offers adjacent sourced topics instead of improvising clinical content.

parts.text: My answer: I would place a stainless steel crown on the tooth after the pulpotomy because it protects the tooth.

property.description: The feedback separately identifies what the candidate got right, what specific content was missing for full marks, and models what a score-3 answer sounds like.
Each missing-content point is supported by a direct quotation from a retrieved guideline or course passage with its source identified, not paraphrased from memory.
Any score given is an integer 1, 2, or 3 for a named blueprint skillset; no percentage, /5, or composite scores appear.
